card.desc:
Account:
Password:
Build Version:v8.9.30.2.2
Device Version:iOS 26.5
Device Name: iPhone 13

[Steps]

- Install and open the Application
- Log in as Guest
- Navigate to the Profile/I section.
- Observe the avatar displayed while the page is loading.
- Verify whether the Purple-Themed default avatar is briefly displayed before the user’s set avatar appears.

[Results]
Kindly refer to the attached file.

[Expected]
Upon navigating to the Profile/I section after a new app installation, the user’s set avatar should be displayed immediately without briefly showing the Purple-Themed default avatar.

Step by Step:

1. Install and Open game 99 apps

- On iOS, the toast message **"推广链接已复制"** (Invitation link copied) disappears after approximately **1 second**, making it difficult to notice/read.

- The toast message should remain visible for a consistent duration across iOS and Android, preferably around **3 seconds**, so users have sufficient time to see and read the message.

**Related:** "Live room: chat message displayed twice" ticket (same account, same room, duplicates also visible in this recording) [https://trello.com/c/SQwWOhlG](https://trello.com/c/SQwWOhlG "smartCard-inline")

Account: +8613074290600
Password: 001226
Build Version: 9.20.1.3
Device Version: 26.6.2
Device: iPhone 13
Account ID: MOBBKJC7S2

While sending chat messages at a normal typing pace, the app repeatedly shows the toast **"发言过于频繁哦，请N秒后再试"** (You're sending too frequently, please try again in N seconds), even though the user typed each message by hand and sent only once per tap.

**Steps to reproduce**

1. Login via guest or the account above.
2. Then select the “关注 (Pay Attention)” tab section
3. Enter a live room with account YiGTcV\_jay\_ios_830.
4. Open the chat input, type a short message and tap send.
5. Type and send another message a few seconds later, and keep going.
6. The rate-limit toast appears from time to time.

**Actual result**

The toast appears four times in the recording, at these video timestamps:

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aab99e4a1681c23fac57cf4/attachments/6ab0dac44864dc7a4c3e470d/previews/6ab0dac54864dc7a4c3e47f5/download/image.webp)

**Observations**

- **Normal pace:** each message is typed out letter by letter between sends. In the stretch I measured, the sends were about 3.5 seconds apart (~1:56 to ~2:00), longer than the 1 to 2 second wait the toast asks for.
- **Input already cleared:** in every toast frame the input box is already empty and the send button is greyed out, so the app treated the message as sent and still showed the error.
- **Wait time changes:** the toast asks for 1 s in some cases and 2 s in others, so the limit is not consistent.
- **Send button spinner:** after a send, the send button shows a loading spinner for roughly 2 to 3 seconds. This suggests the send request is slow to complete.
- **Duplicates in the same recording:** the chat feed shows repeated messages, for example "wewe" twice and later "wuwu" twice, with the toast appearing around them. This may share a root cause with the duplicate message ticket.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aab99e4a1681c23fac57cf4/attachments/6ab0dd5d6af0f8a559624827/previews/6ab0dd5d6af0f8a5596248ca/download/image.webp)

**Expected result**
Messages sent a few seconds apart go through with no warning. The toast should only appear if two messages are really sent within the limit.

cards.desc:
Two UI issues were reported in the app:

1. Paid Live Stream payment button behavior: On the Live Streaming tab, tapping the payment button for the last paid live stream room does not show a confirmation modal before proceeding. When the user has insufficient funds, the app appears to navigate directly to the Recharge tab instead of first showing a payment confirmation step. Build version: v4.9.16.1.2 on iPhone 13 (iOS 26.6.2). Reference video: [Google Drive](https://drive.google.com/open?id=1UurrxNT8TD9Dph5OADvn87orUTZfOLKn&usp=drive_fs).

2. Activity reward table layout issue: In the Activity section, on the VIP特邀回归 page, the reward table container for 豪礼回归2 / 豪礼回归3 overflows past the right side of the screen. This crops the rounded border/frame and decorative background elements, leaving the full container not visible within the viewport. Reported on iPhone 11 (iOS 26.5) with build version v8.9.28.1.2. Reference images are attached in the source card.

Both cards are visual/product behavior issues affecting different app areas and should be tracked together as a combined set of mobile UI defects.

---

Tapping the payment button should first display a confirmation modal, allowing the user to review the payment details (e.g., amount, service) and explicitly confirm before either the payment is processed or the user is redirected to the Recharge tab (in case of insufficient balance).

Step by Step:

1. Install and Open game 99 apps

- A **"Success"** toast message is displayed, indicating that the transfer was successful.
- However, the transferred balance is **not reflected in the game wallet**.

- The transfer should be successfully processed and the transferred amount should be reflected in the corresponding game wallet.
- The displayed **"Success"** toast should only appear when the balance transfer has actually been completed successfully.
- If the transfer fails, the system should display an appropriate failure message instead of **"Success."**
